decisionsTitle: The participant emails: the key facts bold, the one fact on a highlighted band, the button first (amending §68 and §392)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-09-30:** «I need more bold and highlight in the emails sent to participants». The participant emails read as flat paragraphs: the race number, the desk code, the date and start, the place, the deadline to act and the one button to press were buried in prose.

**Decision: one emphasis vocabulary in the renderer, used by every participant message (amending §68 and §392).** `renderContent` (`src/modules/notifications/templates.ts`) knows four things, and a message names them by the words of its own paragraphs rather than by position, so a text the club saved unchanged from the editor (§359) is emphasised as the platform's own is, and one the club rewrote keeps the club's look:

- **Bold** — the one syntax is still `**x**` (§189); `__x__` stays the underline of «Ești deja înscris» (§235). The facts a runner hunts for are bold where they stand: the race number, the desk code, the deadline and the length of an offer, the link's life, the state, "a fost anulată", "nu trebuie să faci nimic". The facts block (§392) bolds the day, the hours and the place's name.
- **The highlighted band** — the one fact a message is about, on a soft band: the club's blue at about 8 % over white (`SITE_TINT.lightBlue`), a 4 px ink-blue left edge, the body's ink one size up (17 px), the same in every message (`EMAIL_EMPHASIS` in `src/theme/brand.ts`). No new colour, no image, no font. Consecutive highlighted paragraphs share one band. The reminder and the new-event alert have no paragraph that says the start and the place, so the §81 facts line itself goes on the band under the greeting, with its links, instead of twice.
- **The button first** — a message that asks one thing puts its button right under the band (or the line that says what the button does), not at the end; same size and style as before (§96), the outlined second choice (§468) with it, «Nu mai pot ajunge» (§558) still under it. Absent or not found, the button stays where it was.
- **Quieter sentences** — "ignore this if it was not you", where the data came from, "Mai jos: …": 14 px in the muted ink.

**The deadline is spelled out.** The hold and the offer's deadline read with the month in full — «vineri, 2 octombrie 2026, la 18:30», "Friday, 2 October 2026, at 18:30" (`formatDeadlineInSentence` in `render.ts`); every other moment keeps the short month. The sample on `/admin/emails` and the guard against saved sample values know both forms (§359).

**The plain-text twin keeps it.** Bold drops its markers as before; each line of the band starts with «▶ », with a blank line above and under the run; an early button is set apart the same way. Nothing else in the text half moves.

**Dark mode.** A message declares itself light (§174); Gmail's app darkens it anyway by inverting it. The pairs are tested as sent and inverted: the words on the band at 4.5:1 or more, the edge against the band at 3:1, the band a visible step from the card, the quiet ink at 4.5:1 (`tests/unit/notifications/email-emphasis.test.ts`).

**Per message type** (the same in Romanian and English; the words unchanged — only the confirmation's code sentence moved up beside the number, so the two facts the desk asks for share the band):

| Message | On the band | Bold | Button |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Verification | "Apasă butonul ca să confirmi adresa…" | the link's life | under the band |
| Declaration request | the place is held — sign the declaration | the declaration; the hold's deadline, spelled | under the band |
| Waiting list joined | the event is full, you are on the list | "pe lista de așteptare" | — |
| Waiting-list offer | the place, the deadline and the hours | the deadline, spelled; the hours | under the band |
| Confirmation | the race number and the desk code | the number, the code; the facts block's day, hours, place | at the end (the QR first) |
| Family confirmation | each person's number and code, one band per person | the name, the code | at the end |
| Family sitting | «Înscriere de familie: …» (§543) | — | under the line that says what it does (§536) |
| Reminder | the start and the place (the facts line) | the number, the code | «Nu mai pot ajunge» (§558) |
| Thanks | "Rezultatele și pozele sunt la linkul de mai jos." | — | under the band |
| Signed declaration (race and group run) | the copy — "Păstreaz-o: este copia ta." | "personal, pe baza actului de identitate"; "nu te înscrie nicăieri" | at the end |
| Race number | the number and the code | the number, the code | at the end |
| Registration opened | "Înscrierile … s-au deschis." | — | under the band |
| Cancellation | the fact, and what it released (§547) | "a fost anulată" | — |
| Offer expired | expired, still on the list | both | — |
| Management link / all my registrations | "Iată linkul …" | the link's life | under the band |
| State notice | the state | the state | — |
| Event update | what changed (§331); with nothing named, the line that says the details changed | "nu trebuie să faci nimic" | at the end |
| Event cancelled | "a fost anulat" | "nu trebuie să faci nimic" | — |
| Another person on the address | the first line; at the limit "Nu am înscris pe nimeni" | — | under the band |
| Newsletter confirmation | what the button does; "Ești deja abonat(ă)" | — | under the band |
| New event alert | the start and the place | — | at the end |
| A re-send (§235) | «Ești deja înscris», with the number bold | — | as the message's |

**Not in scope, and why.** The club's copies (the declaration archives, the confirmation notice), the staff and member invitations, the organizer's message and the newsletter keep their look: the first are the club's own mail, the last two are words the club wrote, and a band the platform draws on someone else's text would say what the writer did not choose. The organizer's message keeps its bold facts line (§81).

**Refused.** A second syntax for the highlight in the club's editor (the band follows the platform's own sentences, which a saved unchanged text still matches); a coloured or image background (Gmail drops or inverts it unpredictably); a larger button (§96 set its size for a thumb already). No dependency, no migration.
changelogLine: - **Bold and a highlighted line in the participant emails** — every message puts its one fact on a soft blue band (the race number and desk code, the offer's deadline, the start and the place, the cancellation), the key facts in bold, the deadline with its month spelled out, the one button right under the line that asks for it, and the side notes quieter; the plain text marks the line with ▶. The previews on «Emailuri» show it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Every participant message puts the one fact it is about on one highlighted band — the club's blue at about 8 % over white, an ink-blue left edge, the same in every message and in both languages — and the plain-text part marks each line of it with «▶ », set apart by blank lines; the club's copies, the staff and member invitations, the organizer's message and the newsletter have no band (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The facts a participant hunts for are bold — the race number, the desk code, the deadline and the length of an offer, the link's life, the state, the facts block's day, hours and place name — and the hold's and the offer's deadline spell the month out («vineri, 2 octombrie 2026, la 18:30», "Friday, 2 October 2026, at 18:30"); the words are otherwise unchanged (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A message that asks one action — the verification, the declaration request, the waiting-list offer, the management links, the thanks, the registration opened, another person on the address, the newsletter confirmation — draws its button, unchanged in size, right under the band rather than at the end, and «Nu mai pot ajunge» stays under it (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The band's colours hold on a light card and on one a client inverts: its words at 4.5:1 or more, its edge at 3:1 against it, the band a visible step from the card, and the quieter sentences' muted ink at 4.5:1 (2026-09-30, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the participant emails get bold facts, a highlighted line and the button first
